name: Round the clock operation
description: Front desks and key systems run all day and night so there is little time for maintenance.

name: Seasonal and outsourced staff
description: Staff change often and many work for contractors.

name: Shared devices
description: Terminals and workstations pass between staff on every shift.

name: Multi property operation
description: Several sites share vendors and accounts and sometimes networks.

name: Franchise or managed model
description: Responsibility for security is split between owner operator and brand.

name: Mixed guest data
description: Card data identity documents and CCTV sit under several legal regimes.

name: Operational override
description: Staff bypass controls to keep service running and the bypass is not recorded.
